invariants.title: The line is heard
invariants.rule: "It's only a bag, Nadia. Put it down and walk out of here." - every word, in his voice.
invariants.why: The whole film turns on the offer; the speech model checks every take for the words.

invariants.title: He does not raise his voice
invariants.rule: Low, rough, unhurried. He waits after the line.
invariants.why: He is the reasonable one; the menace is in the patience.

invariants.title: The camera is still
invariants.why: Nothing should compete with the line.

flair.title: The wait after the line
flair.note: about a second and a half

title: the offer
beat: Hale, calm and patient, makes his offer: "It's only a bag, Nadia. Put it down and walk out of here."
